Journey Insight by Alterian
 
 
 
70% of the customer journey happens where you can't see it
 
 
Journey Insight
 shows you the rest: observed customer behavior 
across your market and your competitors
. Ask a question in plain language and get an answer in minutes with our native AI, or in the tools you already work in via Journey Insight MCP.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Sign up free
 
 
 
 
chevron_right
 
 
See how it works

larger panel than traditional
customer research

real consumers in our
anonymized panel
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
56B
 
 
 
journey interactions and
behavioral signals a year
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
300+
 
 
 
defined markets across
23 industry categories
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Pioneering journey intelligence
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Journey Insight is the only solution that combines one of the world’s largest customer behavior data sets with advanced AI. 
 
 
 
While most tools analyze what happens inside a brand’s owned channels, we reveal the unseen majority of decisions happening elsewhere—transforming them into insights businesses can act on.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Get the insights you need to meet your goals
 
If you’re struggling to understand your customers or keep up with rising expectations, Journey Insight delivers clear, actionable insights to make smarter business decisions.

actionable insights

Why choose Real-Time CX?
 
Real-Time CX means you don't have to choose between addressing the customer's challenges and meeting your business needs.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Increase revenue
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Discover breakpoints in cross-channel journeys and deliver personalized, next-best actions for your customers that increase conversions.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Reduce business costs
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Identify high-volume, high-cost journeys and orchestrate lower cost solutions that prioritize digital-first, self-service resolution.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Improve customer satisfaction
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Drive significant uplift in scores like NPS and CSAT by delivering relevant, real-time experiences to your customers.
